summary.text: Javen Sears is a Republican candidate for the Vermont State Senate in the Chittenden Southeast District, a three-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as nonprofit director, and in a Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a South Burlington native and University of Vermont business school senior.

paragraphs.text: Javen Sears said in a Ballotpedia survey that he graduated from South Burlington High School in 2020 and is a senior at the University of Vermont's Grossman School of Business.
He said he competes in collegiate debate at UVM, previously served as president of the UVM Club Football team, and is an associate intern at the Vermont Center for Emerging Technologies.
He also said he serves as vice president and head fifth- and sixth-grade football coach for the South Burlington Dolphins Foundation.

Sears listed his campaign messages as economic policies that protect small towns and local businesses, schools where families can send their children, and fewer regulatory burdens on small businesses.
He named parental control in education, youth development, economic growth, fiscal responsibility and public safety as policy areas he cares about.
